name: Hontanares de Eresma (Spain)
description: Seven horizontal stripes of red, white, blue, white, blue, white and red in the proportions 2:1:1:2:1:1:2.
history: Hontanares de Eresma adopted its arms and flag officially on 31 May 2005, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 14 June 2005; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of seven horizontal stripes in the proportions 1/5, 1/10, 1/10, 1/5, 1/10, 1/10 and 1/5.
